com.elo.device.peripherals

Interface BarCodeReader


  • public interface BarCodeReader
    This interface provides methods by which an application can interact with the Bar Code reader present in an Elo View device

    • Method Detail

      • setEnabled

        void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
        This method is used to enable or disable Bar Code reader. See BcrEnableControl, provided by the Inventory class, for details of what level of enable control is available
        Parameters:
        enabled -

      • getStatus

        Status getStatus()
        This method returns the enable/disable status of the Bar Code Reader. On some models, this information may not be available
        Returns:
        Current status of the reader
        See Also:
        Status

      • getModelName

        java.lang.String getModelName()
        This method returns the Bar Code Model Name as a string. In the product/platform where there is an integrated Bar Code reader present, this will return the product/platform name as Model Name
        Returns:
        The name of the model
        See Also:
        EloPlatform

      • getFirmwareVersion

        java.lang.String getFirmwareVersion()
                             throws UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        This method returns the Firmware Version installed on Bar Code reader. In the cases where Bar Code Reader is built in, this will throw UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        Returns:
        Firmware version, as a String
        Throws:
        UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException

      • setTriggerMode

        void setTriggerMode(TriggerMode triggerMode)
        This method allows the Application to set the Trigger Mode for the Bar Code reader. If trigger mode is not supported, this method will have no effect. This is specifically in the case of PayPoint 1.0 and Rev B platforms
        Parameters:
        triggerMode - Trigger mode to set
        See Also:
        TriggerMode

      • beep

        void beep(BeepType beepType)
        This method allows the application to set the BeepType for the Bar Code Reader. If BeepType is not supported, this method will have no effect. This is specifically in the case of PayPoint 1.0 and Rev B platforms
        Parameters:
        beepType -
        See Also:
        BeepType

      • setKbMode

        void setKbMode()
        This method sets the Barcode reader into keyboard mode

      • isKbMode

        boolean isKbMode()
        This method determines if the Barcode reader is in keyboard mode
        Returns:
        true if the reader is in keyboard mode, false otherwise

      • setBarcodeReadCallback

        void setBarcodeReadCallback(BarCodeReader.BarcodeReadCallback callback)
        Sets or clears the callback that is invoked when the barcode scanner reads a code. It is recommended that the callback be cleared when the owning Activity is stopped. If the installed barcode scanner does not support a callback, or if the scanner is in keyboard mode, this method will have no effect.
        Parameters:
        callback - Callback to be invoked, or null to clear

      • sendCommand

        byte[] sendCommand(byte[] command)
        Send a command to the barcode scanner, and return the result. Note: a reader callback must already be installed when using this command
        Parameters:
        command - ASCII string of bytes to be sent as the command. It is assumed that the length of the command is equal to the size of the byte[] array passed in.
        Returns:
        Byte string of the reply from the scanner. Returns null if command was not sent due to error condition.
